hierarchy.observation: Library/Environments breadcrumb, Create an environment heading and three plain entry labels communicate purpose. Photo flow separates Add views/Reconstruct/Review & edit, then room geometry summary, preview, notes and Apply/Discard.

typography.observation: Short card explanations are legible against raised blue surfaces; file constraints, approximation warning, selected view count and metres remain explicit. Phone text wraps without horizontal clipping at390px.
typography.limits: No Light typography sample or complete long-name/translation stress matrix.

spacing.observation: Desktop choice cards have consistent margins/gaps. Tall photo dialog scrolls within viewport; Close/title remain at top while review/Apply occupy lower section. Permission withdrawal is below the current visible fold, so still images alone do not establish its accessibility.
spacing.limits: No inferred inaccessible control from below-fold position; source confirms overflow:auto/sticky header.
